decisions.reason: It is strongly rooted in the firm's existing modular recycling-system knowledge and the documented customer savings indicate clear value that the firm can further exploit through service feedback and R&D.

As a mobile slow-speed shredder close to the core offer, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and should benefit from cumulative learning from installed machines, maintenance and application support.
Because this flagship modular plant concept aligns closely with the firm's strategic direction and core capabilities, management is more likely to refine and expand it than withdraw it.

This new shredder line is highly related to the firm's established machinery and to Product B, so existing know-how, in-house development and customer feedback make continued improvement more likely than exit.

Although somewhat newer and slightly less proven than the other kept products, the mobile spiral shaft screens still build on the firm's screening and materials-processing competence and can be developed further with its R&D and research links.
